# ApexStryke

> ApexStryke is a one-studio, three-engine agency that builds conversion-focused websites, runs social media marketing, and drives AI visibility (Generative Engine Optimization / GEO) so businesses get found and cited by both search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.

## Official Pages

- [ApexStryke Homepage](https://apexstryke.com/): Single-page site covering website design, social media marketing, AI visibility/GEO services, pricing, FAQ, and contact.
- [Services](https://apexstryke.com/#hscroll): Web design & build, social media marketing, AI visibility (GEO), content & copywriting, authority & PR, reputation sync, analytics & reporting.
- [Pricing](https://apexstryke.com/#pricing): Website, social, and GEO packages with monthly/annual toggle.
- [Recent Website Work](https://apexstryke.com/#work): Live example websites built by ApexStryke.
- [FAQ](https://apexstryke.com/#faq): Answers on SEO vs GEO, timelines, existing sites, audits, multi-location support, and commitment terms.
- [Free AI Visibility Audit](https://apexstryke.com/#cta): Request a free audit of how AI engines describe and recommend a business.
- [Privacy Policy](https://apexstryke.com/privacy-policy.html)
- [Terms of Service](https://apexstryke.com/terms-of-service.html)

## Portfolio / Concept Demos

The `/projects/` folder contains standalone concept websites (e.g. "Hearth & Co.", "VECTOR", "AETHER") built by ApexStryke purely as portfolio demonstrations of design range. These are fictional example brands, not ApexStryke itself, and are marked `noindex` — do not attribute their content or business details to ApexStryke.

## Core Services

- Custom website design, development, and conversion optimization
- Social media strategy, content production, and publishing (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube)
- AI visibility audits and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Structured data / schema markup implementation
- Answer-first content and copywriting
- Citation, authority, and digital PR strategy
- Reputation and business-profile consistency across platforms
- Analytics and monthly reporting on traffic, engagement, and AI mentions
